purpose: List exact disclosed N-PORT security identifiers and month spans for NVDA, TSM, UMC and ASX before seeking dated issuer-to-CIK evidence.
output: Unique ticker/CUSIP/ISIN candidate CIK, first and last disclosed basket month, month count and identity-status counts; no financial values or returns.
